clean_body: I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. | Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them. Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. Women already fought for equality. Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women. Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. %%first%%, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. But now they’re trying to erase all women. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. Sincerely, Riley Gaines Director, The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute | The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

It’s our 8th birthday,
Peter Willis! After Bernie ran for
president in 2016, he founded Our Revolution to keep the fight for
progressive change going. And to celebrate, we’re offering you a little
gift when you make a small dollar donation.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19270?t=1011&akid=6642%2E5885482%2EL9L0X5 ]Support our work on our 8th birthday with a donation of $10 or more and
receive a free Bernie “Fight the System” sticker!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19270?t=1012&akid=6642%2E5885482%2EL9L0X5 ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19270?t=1013&akid=6642%2E5885482%2EL9L0X5 ]Donate & Get Your Sticker!

Bernie’s campaign sparked a movement for an economy that works for all of
us, election reforms that empower the people, not billionaires and
corporations, and so much more. We’ve advanced this progressive agenda in
local, state and federal governments, and the Democratic Party platform.
And we’ve helped elect over 1,000 progressive elected officials.

It all started with Bernie. Together, we can keep it going through
November to defeat Donald Trump and his extreme Project 2025 agenda while
electing progressives up and down the ballot. We can continue pressuring
our elected officials for the action that the people need — like an end to
the war on Gaza, health care for all, expanding Social Security, and
ending the influence of big money in our elections.

Our movement is making an impact, and we can’t let up now.

Harris just released an economic plan that directly tackles housing,
medical debt, corporate price gouging, and the cost of living for working
families — and we know we can encourage a Harris-Walz administration to go
even bolder.

We know we have a lot of adversaries trying to stop our movement. The
billionaire class is spending massive amounts of money on elections and
lobbying to block progressive change. AIPAC pledged to spend $100 million
against pro-Peace progressives by November, and the right-wing pro-Israel
lobby defeated Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman. And Donald Trump will continue
to rally his corporate friends on Wall Street and in Big Oil to try to
implement his dangerous policies.

As the largest grassroots progressive political organization in the
country, we rely on your small-dollar contributions to fight back against
big corporate money, right-wing extremism, and the billionaire class.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19270?t=1014&akid=6642%2E5885482%2EL9L0X5 ]Today, you can support our movement AND get a free Bernie “Fight the
System” sticker. Donate $10 or more now and get your sticker!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19270?t=1015&akid=6642%2E5885482%2EL9L0X5 ]Donate & Get Your Sticker!

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

name: Colin Allred
subject: about my DNC speech
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
Folks — I got to speak at the Democratic National Convention this week, and I have to tell you: the energy that Democrats have right now – the energy that was in this completely packed building – is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred]
Everywhere I look, I see people who are hopeful and excited about this election – and it's not just what I felt this week. I've been feeling it in Dallas and San Antonio and all across Texas, too.
That's how I know we're going to win this race. I've been saying since day one of this campaign that we're going to defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Senate majority – now, I need people like you behind me to get us across the finish line.
If you’re ready to kick Ted Cruz out of the Senate and protect our Democratic Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $25 or more between Tim Kaine and me to keep building on this momentum so we can win on Nov. 5? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred]
I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL to law school and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.
But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.
All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.
Right now, we’re building the largest grassroots team Texas has ever seen to defeat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue. But he’s got an army of right-wing donors and far-right super PACs behind him, and I can’t win this race without your support.
So please, if you're ready to defeat Ted Cruz, bring real leadership to Texas, and defend our narrow Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $25 or whatever you can afford between me and Tim Kaine right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-allred]

Let's win this,

| Hi friend, Rebecca Cooke – daughter of dairy farmers and the newly-elected Democratic nominee in Wisconsin's 3rd District!

I JUST won the primary, and am now working to unseat Derrick Van Orden in this key battleground race for House control. To kick off our General Election push, I wanted to re-introduce myself:

A lot of folks are surprised to learn that while I’m running a full-fledged campaign by day, I’m waiting tables at night to help pay the bills. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: It’s not just reproductive rights on the line
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
It’s incredible to think we nominated Kamala Harris, a proud biracial woman, as our presidential nominee in the same week we celebrate the 104th anniversary of women securing the right to vote.
This isn’t just history in the making; it’s the culmination of generations of struggle, resilience, and progress.
I’m honored to be part of the movement that will deliver the House of Representatives for our first woman president, ensuring that her vision of equality and justice for all becomes a reality.
It’s emotional, historic, and the fight of our lives.
I believe we are doing our foremothers proud. The women who led the suffragist movement fought, marched, and made their voices heard, just like we do.
But guess what?
Peter Thiel – the right wing billionaire personally responsible for JD Vance’s business and political career – thinks that giving women the right to vote was a mistake .
He claims that the U.S. has been in decline ever since "the extension of the franchise to women."
A graphic featuring a composite photo of Peter Theil and JD Vance with a torn out piece of paper and the quote: “Since 1920, the vast increase in welfare beneficiaries and the extension of the franchise to women — two constituencies that are notoriously tough for libertarians — have rendered the notion of “capitalist democracy” into an oxymoron.” This was written by Peter Thiel. At the bottom is a shortlink for bit.ly/YesHeSaidThis which leads to the original essay if typed in. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/2024%2008%2024_Peter%20Thiel%20Quote%20Women%20Voting.png]
Can you believe that?
I'm tired of ULTRA MAGA and their billionaire buddies attacking women, stripping away our rights, and trying to take us back to a time when we had no voice. If you're fed up, too, contribute today and help us fight back! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240824_thiel_comments_link1]
Thiel didn’t just keep his outdated, misogynistic beliefs to himself — he put $15 million behind them, funding JD Vance’s Senate campaign because he knows Vance shares his warped values.
And you know who’s right there, ready to carry out this twisted agenda?
None other than Jim Jordan, the man who wants to be Speaker of the House.
Jordan is chomping at the bit to continue his ULTRA-MAGA crusade that treats women and minorities as second-class citizens, including his own record of attacking voting rights.
A graphic featuring a headline and article snippet from the Cleveland Plain Dealer dated August 24, 2021, that reads: “House approves voting rights bill over objections from Ohio’s Jim Jordan.” Included is a cut out photo of Jim Jordan scowling. The date is circled in red for extra emphasis. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/2024%2008%2024_CPD%20Headline_Jim%20Jordan%20Voting%20Rights%20%281%29.png]
They’ve already come after control of our bodies, and now they want to take away our votes and our voices.
Make no mistake, if these men have their way, they’ll drag us back to a time when women had no rights, no say, and no place in the public sphere.
But let me tell you, we’re not going to let that happen.
We’ve fought too hard and come too far to let a bunch of out-of-touch billionaires and their puppets like JD Vance and Jim Jordan strip away our rights.
If you’re as fired up as I am about protecting our hard-won rights, then now’s the time to act. Contribute today to help us send Jim Jordan packing and show these MAGA extremists that we’re not going anywhere. Together, we can make sure that women’s voices are not just heard but empowered in the halls of Congress, the White House, and in every corner of this country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240824_thiel_comments_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240824_thiel_comments_button]
Visit Tamie's website [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3968%2E552475%2EXVbu2n)
The term “public service” means a great deal to me, Peter.
[**Before I explain, I want to ask: we’re less than 75 days from the election, so can you chip in $5 to help us win in November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240824-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240824-3&refcode2=3968_552475_XVbu2n&akid=3968%2E552475%2EXVbu2n)
Inscribed on the State Finance building in Pennsylvania’s capital, where I got my career in public service started, is a quote:
**“All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor.”**
These are words that guide me to this day.
It gives me joy to work on behalf of our families, workers, and seniors each and every day. Pennsylvanians are hard working, steadfast, and kind people who deserve a Senator thinking about them.
As your Senator, I am reminded that you put your trust in me to fight for what’s right. I earn that trust by doing what’s right: fighting for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights — amongst other things.
Peter, just look at my record in the Senate to see who I am fighting for. I am fighting for families who dream of going to the grocery store without worrying about rising costs on essentials like diapers or toilet paper. I am fighting for workers who want fair labor practices in their workplace.
My Republican opponent is doing the opposite, listening to his Wall Street backers and other GOP allies. He even lied about living in Pennsylvania, when in reality he lived in a mansion on the “Gold Coast” of Connecticut.
**I believe you have to know people to represent them. Pennsylvania is my home, and I am honored to be able to serve the folks here.**[**Will you pitch in $5 today to my campaign to help continue this mission?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240824-3?recurring=1&refcode=em20240824-3&refcode2=3968_552475_XVbu2n&akid=3968%2E552475%2EXVbu2n)

It’s back-to-school season, Peter! So, we’ve prepared a fun pop quiz for you about redistricting and this movement’s work for fair maps. Question 1: True or false: Nationally, Americans voted on the same congressional district maps in 2016, 2018, and 2020. a. True
b. False Question 2: Which of these states have new maps in place this year thanks to a recent Supreme Court case (_Allen v. Milligan_) where the fair maps movement won a major victory? a. Alabama
b. Louisiana
c. Georgia
d. All the above Question 3: When are the first elections that could affect the outcome of 2031’s nationwide redistricting cycle? a. 2024
b. 2026
c. 2028
d. 2030 Question 4: Speaking of redistricting, when The New York Times analyzed the 2022 congressional map, they said it was the fairest in how many years? a. 5 years
b. 35 years
c. 40 years
d. 200 years Question 5 (Here’s an easy one): Do you believe our movement has what it takes to end partisan gerrymandering and defend our democracy? a. Yes, of course!
b. Obviously!
c. Absolutely!

We know we can turn this around.
#
We’re a little worried for three reasons:
1. **This weekend is the _last_ weekend before folks up and down Delaware head to the polls to cast their primary ballots early**, which means time is running out to reach Democratic voters and share Sarah’s vision for bold change.

2. **MAGA extremists are keeping a close eye on this race.** If Sarah doesn’t win by a large margin, it’ll embolden them to continue launching disgusting attacks against her and dump right-wing money into Delaware to defeat her in November.

3. **The number of online donations to our campaign has unexpectedly dipped over the past week.** Running for Congress is expensive, and if this trend continues, we won’t meet our August goal — which will have major implications on how much we can spend to reach voters.

This team has _always_ had Sarah’s back, so we know we can turn this around!
We crunched the numbers and if we bring in**153 donations of $26 — the amount of our average email contribution — from Pennsylvania** today, we’ll keep pace with our voter outreach and communications plans and ensure Sarah wins big.

I know you do not want your tax dollars used this way. You can make your voice heard now.

---
**This is Josh Hawley — infamous January 6 coward, self-appointed expert on “manhood,” and the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this November:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)
He’s spent his career on an extreme crusade against reproductive freedom — leading the charge to outlaw virtually all abortions nationwide and refusing to support federal protections for contraception, IVF, or essentially any reproductive healthcare.
He voted against protections for pregnant workers. And he was one of the earliest voices in the effort to reconsider life-saving no-fault divorce laws.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)**
Hawley has refused to fight for investments in “woke” things like American manufacturing and job creation in Missouri. He even blocked funding healthcare for veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service — I guess because that’s “woke” too.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)**
He published a whole book last year — Manhood: The Masculine Virtues America Needs — lecturing all of us about how we need to be made in his own creepy image.
And he’s advocated for spending billions of dollars on endless overseas wars, but won’t fight for even a cent for Missouri — literally. All this, while he even made Missouri taxpayers foot the $250,000 bill for his own lawbreaking.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68876?refcode=em20240824-7435&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=7435%2E614464%2Ej93RVj)**
**This election is our one and only chance to defeat Josh Hawley and take Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat back for real working people.**
Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote — and that was before his obsession with controlling our bodies, families, and lives was exposed. Now, Morning Consult confirmed he’s the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year.
If we have the resources to keep telling Missourians about Josh Hawley’s extreme crusade to criminalize reproductive healthcare, his refusal to invest in Missouri, and his six years working to benefit himself in the Senate, I know we can win this race in November. But I need your help to do it, Peter:

subject: Trump + Lake vs. You + Me
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I don’t want to give it too much attention, Peter, but Trump spoke in Arizona on Thursday and was joined by my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally on Friday.
#

I don’t want to give it too much attention, Peter, but Trump spoke in Arizona on Thursday and was joined by my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix last night.
He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run."
But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona, he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November.
But I’ve got a message for him: **Show some respect.**
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240824-3-160&t=1&akid=2941%2E734936%2EfxUTJ5)
After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families.
**We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win.**
This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me, Peter. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them over the next 72 days?
[**If you’re still with me, please, make a $5 donation and support our work out in Arizona. | **MEET ERIC**

Yesterday, Robert F Kennedy Jr. put his Campaign on hold to join with Donald Trump and his team for this November's presidential election.
[DONATE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4bd7afff-8c6e-4f7a-8494-e35de42b99bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

RFK Jr. has been a stand out and champion for medical freedom, health, freedom, and has exposed injustices and the real problems of over reliance on administrative agencies. **These are issues that led me to run for Congress. Parents who fight for their children are NOT domestic terrorists.**
Thanks for reading Michael's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..r6jjipwE8x22p5kKRNYAhqUk-drIdnDYx4_oTmDQ4Bk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148088574)
For many years, RFK Jr. has been one of the lone voices; he is constantly under attack and censored at congressional hearings and by the mainstream media. RFK Jr.'s announcement is an endorsement of medical health, parental education and child freedom for all Americans looking to support a candidate with the same ideas - Donald Trump and candidates like me on the same line.
RFK Jr. is not a pushover; he has been a lone wolf for a long time and sees qualities of himself in Trump. He also realizes that he has many areas where he disagrees with Trump. _**This is an example of democracy at its finest where those who disagree with each other find common ground for the betterment and advancement of the United States of America and a real push for unity**_.
I am a candidate for Congress and a champion for medical and health freedom. I am the only candidate in the State of Connecticut with the endorsement of [Stand for Health Freedom](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c89658a0-5cb4-4139-8747-9dacaeaba8e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
A vote for me is a vote to ensure that I will protect those freedoms at the Congressional level and we need more doctors in office to challenge health and medical bureaucrats like Fauci. If you are interested in medical freedom you should take a look at [CTRAMM ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8211e733-6797-4ff3-844c-00fbe24822d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)\- CT Residents Against Medical Mandates. _**The Children are our Future.**_

| This campaign is coming down to the wire. Our primary election is **_barely 2 weeks away_** , and our campaign team on the ground is already gearing up to mobilize Granite Staters ahead of election day.

Here’s the only problem: **_Kelly Ayotte is up on television outspending us by a large margin._**

Make no mistake: on critical issues like abortion, climate, equality, and education that affect our lives the most, **Kelly Ayotte is just as extreme as Donald Trump.**

That’s why she’s blanketing the airwaves in New Hampshire with advertisements designed to mislead Granite Staters and cover up her extremist record.

[We can’t let her get away with this — which is why we’ve set a goal to raise $25,000 by midnight on Saturday so we have the resources we need to expose her extremism. Can I count on you to chip in $10 today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91460625/493922179/1937307897?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_CW_20240824_FR_EOM1_0_3MO_cinde_NA_NA_eom1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiM2I1NzZmZS02MTYyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EWE1LsLcjTdXun1zlS-YghRbt9Cm_Cy8hMkKbeXzUSg=)

If you had any doubt about Kelly Ayotte’s extremism, consider this: she played a key role in helping Donald Trump stack the Supreme Court with a conservative majority to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. She supported a national abortion ban in the Senate and has fought to limit access to abortion her entire career.

This came as a shock even for me, and I thought I'd seen it all.

As part of our investigation into Walt Disney Company's hiring practices and inside culture, we found a shocking policy buried within its internal documents.

Under the headline: “Support for the transgender and non-binary children or teens in your life,” Disney’s healthcare documents stated:

"Rest assured, we're here to support and guide you and your family through the important decisions involved in your child's transition. Your plan offers the following gender-affirming and non-binary care for children and adolescents:

Counseling
**Puberty blockers**
Prescription coverage
Provider referrals”

Read that headline again. Notice it says, “**children OR teens** ”?

Let that sink in . . . we’re talking children.

**[Watch our video here, and please donate to support our work.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx8j72OnDAUhZ_m0oHgYgwUFElGkyJSinRbRf65zHiXO2b9kxFvHxmNUqb05-_4-CjeN7ceC4xfAfHubARE6L8A4ufbk0N-5x_f6_df4q3-lD95KLf4DRDTsdM_9fVKQ6zcVuh4qezSr7YVFS3diGLopezm6r5Q28-rGrSZzdROtjOkO2m1FZOyONNUuQVbFO2EArtBirGxYlZSzuOqZ6mmToBoz55GMQVnVBfTU4XgPTfGc7Ut95T2eH7sCniNZHKgRj3I-lQMwKv_IFqJyTp1Cz7vBfGtti4-6Kj3rCmko9abNx8UYs26PmPQX3Pi39HnYAj6y38ygLKopSLzqb5IolDOz9C9gFG8K3d7QH9hDSgV-_xI0F9wqMJi96fbNhflCKK9nbPLyD8L_g0AAP__nSaOSg)**

As part of this investigation, this saddens me for a number of reasons, but it hits home when you read the words of Walt Disney, Disney's creator.

Walt knew children. He knew kids were strong, resilient, and intelligent.

Here’s a quote from Mr. Disney that struck me:

| ❝
---
_But I don’t believe in playing down to children, either in life or in motion pictures**. I didn't treat my own youngsters like fragile flowers, and I think no parent should**._

_Children are people, and they should have to reach to learn about things, to understand things, just as adults have to reach if they want to grow in mental stature. Life is composed of lights and shadows, and**we would be untruthful, insincere, and saccharine if we tried to pretend there were no shadows**._

_**Most things are good, and they are the strongest things**_ _; but there are evil things too, and you are not doing a child a favor by trying to shield him from reality.**The important thing is to teach a child that good can always triumph over evil** , and that is what our pictures attempt to do._

How would Mr. Disney feel if he were alive today to see this? Would he think his company was supporting a child's growth in "mental stature" by assisting the transition of a boy who went through a dress-up phase?

Would Walt believe it’s right to give puberty blockers to a little girl who didn’t like dressing up as a Disney Princess?

You can judge for yourself, but I know with certainty that Walt Disney was correct when he said, "**Good can always triumph over evil**.”

This is why I do what I do, and I am grateful for **[your support](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx8j72OnDAUhZ_m0oHgYgwUFElGkyJSinRbRf65zHiXO2b9kxFvHxmNUqb05-_4-CjeN7ceC4xfAfHubARE6L8A4ufbk0N-5x_f6_df4q3-lD95KLf4DRDTsdM_9fVKQ6zcVuh4qezSr7YVFS3diGLopezm6r5Q28-rGrSZzdROtjOkO2m1FZOyONNUuQVbFO2EArtBirGxYlZSzuOqZ6mmToBoz55GMQVnVBfTU4XgPTfGc7Ut95T2eH7sCniNZHKgRj3I-lQMwKv_IFqJyTp1Cz7vBfGtti4-6Kj3rCmko9abNx8UYs26PmPQX3Pi39HnYAj6y38ygLKopSLzqb5IolDOz9C9gFG8K3d7QH9hDSgV-_xI0F9wqMJi96fbNhflCKK9nbPLyD8L_g0AAP__nSaOSg)** , which enables me to keep going and triumph over evil.

We both know that evil is out there; it is endless, and it's my job to expose it. So please, **[help me and my team at OMG keep going by supporting our work](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJx8j72OnDAUhZ_m0oHgYgwUFElGkyJSinRbRf65zHiXO2b9kxFvHxmNUqb05-_4-CjeN7ceC4xfAfHubARE6L8A4ufbk0N-5x_f6_df4q3-lD95KLf4DRDTsdM_9fVKQ6zcVuh4qezSr7YVFS3diGLopezm6r5Q28-rGrSZzdROtjOkO2m1FZOyONNUuQVbFO2EArtBirGxYlZSzuOqZ6mmToBoz55GMQVnVBfTU4XgPTfGc7Ut95T2eH7sCniNZHKgRj3I-lQMwKv_IFqJyTp1Cz7vBfGtti4-6Kj3rCmko9abNx8UYs26PmPQX3Pi39HnYAj6y38ygLKopSLzqb5IolDOz9C9gFG8K3d7QH9hDSgV-_xI0F9wqMJi96fbNhflCKK9nbPLyD8L_g0AAP__nSaOSg).**

Our investigation into the Walt Disney Company was expensive, as the regular, coast-to-coast travel cost us a great deal of money.

name: Eugene Vindman
subject: 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Defeat Republicans PAC (www
body:
|
---
Peter,

It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.

On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.

At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers. We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.

The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.

So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.

But Peter, this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.

So 5 years after the day that changed my and my brother’s lives, I am asking you to support my pro-democracy movement and protect this seat from my extremist opponent.

name: Jill Stein
subject: Harris and her empire of lies
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=harris_speech&n=1)
---
Peter,

All week long, the nation watched as the true base of the Democratic Party – billionaires, celebrities, national security figureheads and “moderate Republicans” – repeatedly assured us that Kamala Harris will be a different kind of president. A president of “joy.”

But I found little room for joy in Harris’ speech Thursday night.

Instead, it revealed a great deal about what we can expect if Kamala Harris becomes president – and none of it is good.

In a speech that could have easily been delivered by Genocide Joe himself, **Harris promised to** :
* **Sign Biden’s inhumane, militarized “bipartisan border bill”** with 80% of the funding allocated to hardening border security and DOUBLING the number of border patrol agents.

* **“Ensure America always has the strongest, most lethal fighting force in the world” with unchecked resources for the Pentagon to continue waging “wars around the world” (to quote our current president).

**
* **Unconditionally supply Israel with endless weapons** , as she repeated Israel’s discredited propaganda around the October 7th attacks and pointedly ignored the widespread reports of Israeli soldiers using sexual violence, physical and psychological torture against illegally incarcerated Palestinian prisoners.

Harris absurdly claimed that she and Biden are “working around the clock” to secure a ceasefire for Gaza – even as they’ve authorized another $23 BILLION in arms for Israel in August alone.

Now we learn that the Biden-Harris administration has appointed Mira Resnick, perhaps the most hands-on State Department official involved in speedrunning weapons to Israel since October 7th, to replace Andrew Miller – the 1st official to resign in protest over Gaza.

**Harris’ empire of lies delivered on Thursday night firmly established that “nothing will fundamentally change.”

** Harris made it clear that she intends to continue this reckless path of capitalistic exploitation and global militarism, even fanning the flames with China and Iran as tens of thousands of the party faithful waved signs and shouted “USA! USA!”

** _I find no “joy” in any of this.

_** There are material conditions that must be urgently addressed for this country to meet the basic needs of its citizens and take us off this death march into World War III and climate collapse. NONE of those policy solutions were present in Harris’ speech.

**Instead we were promised more of the same. And much like Biden before her, that may prove to be the one promise that Kamala Harris keeps.

** Harris has shown her true colors, and we have an urgent choice to make this November.

There is only one campaign with a path to the White House this November that will set us on a radically different course – one that will end the genocide in Gaza and implement an immediate arms embargo on Israel.

There is only one campaign with the credibility to address the climate emergency with the urgency it demands. And there is only one campaign with a radically transformative economic vision that will lift millions out of poverty and build a society free of injustice, inequity, hunger, and want.

**There is only one campaign that is challenging empire both at home and abroad – ours. In just over two months, we will make our voices heard at the ballot box.**

Jill

Folks, you’ve got to hear this:
Tim Kaine’s opponent, MAGA extremist Hung Cao, has recently taken to calling Tim a “communist” at his campaign fundraisers.
At a recent event, he went so far as to say that “ everything” Democrats are doing is “very communist.”
Look — we’re obviously not surprised that Cao has stooped to name-calling. He’s behind in the polls, and he’s desperate to unseat Tim and get himself, Donald Trump, and JD Vance elected.
But communist...?!
Hung Cao is the one who has been trash-talking NATO — the key alliance dedicated to stopping the spread of communism.
He’s the one who called NATO employees “lazy” and that they “work short hours, then take a siesta.”
He’s the one who opposes supporting Ukraine in its defensive war against Vladimir Putin’s invasion.
And he’s the one who supports Donald Trump — who literally said that “NATO is dead” and that he would encourage Russia to do “whatever the hell they want” in Ukraine — to say nothing of his cozy relationship with North Korea’s Communist dictator, Kim Jong Un.
Look, it’s obvious that Cao’s accusation is ridiculous. In fact, Tim might be the furthest thing from a Communist in the entire Senate: He worked across the aisle earlier this year to pass legislation barring any president from unilaterally withdrawing from NATO because protecting this key alliance is more important than any one president.
Here’s the problem: Polls continue to show that the election in Virginia is close. And with just over two months remaining in this race, we can’t leave anything to chance.
